negotiate.en: Both sides agreed to negotiate a new schedule before the semester began.
negotiate.zh: 雙方同意在學期開始前協商新的時程。

negotiation.en: The negotiation continued until both groups accepted the final plan.
negotiation.zh: 協商持續到兩組都接受最後方案為止。

neutral.en: The teacher remained neutral while students discussed the controversial issue.
neutral.zh: 學生討論具爭議的議題時，老師保持中立。

nevertheless.en: The weather was poor; nevertheless, the outdoor event continued as planned.
nevertheless.zh: 天氣不好；儘管如此，戶外活動仍按計畫進行。

notion.en: The experiment challenged the common notion that the material was completely stable.
notion.zh: 這項實驗挑戰了這種材料完全穩定的普遍觀念。

numerous.en: Numerous studies have examined how sleep affects learning and memory.
numerous.zh: 許多研究探討了睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

objective.en: The main objective of the project is to reduce unnecessary waste.
objective.zh: 這項專題的主要目標是減少不必要的浪費。

obligation.en: Students have an obligation to follow the laboratory safety rules.
obligation.zh: 學生有義務遵守實驗室安全規定。

obtain.en: Researchers must obtain reliable data before drawing a conclusion.
obtain.zh: 研究人員在下結論前必須取得可靠資料。

obvious.en: It became obvious that the first method was less efficient.
obvious.zh: 很明顯第一種方法效率較低。

occasion.en: On this occasion, the school invited several former students to speak.
occasion.zh: 這次學校邀請了幾位校友來演講。

occupy.en: Large shelves occupy most of the space along the back wall.
occupy.zh: 大型書架占據了後牆大部分空間。

occur.en: Small errors can occur when measurements are recorded too quickly.
occur.zh: 測量數據記錄得太快時，可能會出現小錯誤。

odd.en: The machine made an odd sound before it suddenly stopped.
odd.zh: 那台機器突然停止前發出奇怪的聲音。

official.en: The official announcement will be posted on the school website tomorrow.
official.zh: 正式公告明天會發布在學校網站上。

operate.en: Only trained students may operate the equipment during the experiment.
operate.zh: 只有受過訓練的學生可以在實驗中操作設備。

operation.en: The operation of the new system requires careful testing first.
operation.zh: 新系統的運作需要先經過仔細測試。

opponent.en: The team studied its opponent carefully before the final match.
opponent.zh: 球隊在決賽前仔細研究了對手。

oppose.en: Some residents oppose the plan because they fear increased traffic.
oppose.zh: 一些居民反對這項計畫，因為他們擔心交通增加。

opposition.en: The proposal faced strong opposition from several community groups.
opposition.zh: 這項提案遭到幾個社區團體的強烈反對。

option.en: Taking the train is often a convenient option for city travel.
option.zh: 搭火車通常是城市旅行方便的選擇。

ordinary.en: An ordinary object can become useful in a creative experiment.
ordinary.zh: 普通物品在有創意的實驗中也能變得有用。

organize.en: Please organize the information before writing your final report.
organize.zh: 寫最後報告前請先整理資訊。

origin.en: The museum display explains the origin of several local traditions.
origin.zh: 博物館展示說明了幾項地方傳統的起源。

original.en: Each group must present an original idea for the final project.
original.zh: 每組都必須為期末專題提出原創想法。

outcome.en: The final outcome depended on how carefully the data were analyzed.
outcome.zh: 最後結果取決於資料分析得多仔細。

overall.en: The overall quality of the report improved after several revisions.
overall.zh: 經過幾次修改後，報告的整體品質提升了。

owe.en: I owe my improvement to regular practice and helpful feedback.
owe.zh: 我的進步要歸功於規律練習與有幫助的回饋。

participation.en: Active participation often makes group discussions more productive.
participation.zh: 積極參與通常能讓小組討論更有效率。

particular.en: This particular example shows why accurate measurement is important.
particular.zh: 這個特定例子說明了精確測量為何重要。

pattern.en: The graph reveals a clear pattern in the monthly data.
pattern.zh: 圖表顯示每月資料中有明顯模式。

perceive.en: People may perceive the same event differently depending on experience.
perceive.zh: 人們可能因經驗不同而對同一事件有不同理解。

percentage.en: The percentage of students using digital textbooks increased this year.
percentage.zh: 今年使用電子課本的學生比例增加了。

perform.en: Students must perform the experiment exactly as the instructions describe.
perform.zh: 學生必須完全按照說明進行實驗。

performance.en: Her performance improved after she changed her practice routine.
performance.zh: 她改變練習方式後，表現有所提升。

permit.en: The rules permit students to use calculators for this section.
permit.zh: 規定允許學生在這個部分使用計算機。

perspective.en: Reading different sources can help students develop a broader perspective.
perspective.zh: 閱讀不同來源能幫助學生建立更廣的觀點。

phenomenon.en: The lesson explains the natural phenomenon using a simple classroom experiment.
phenomenon.zh: 這堂課用簡單的課堂實驗解釋這個自然現象。

policy.en: The school introduced a new policy to reduce food waste.
policy.zh: 學校推出新政策以減少食物浪費。

portion.en: Only a small portion of the data showed unusual results.
portion.zh: 只有一小部分資料顯示異常結果。

pose.en: The sudden change may pose a challenge for small businesses.
pose.zh: 這項突然的改變可能對小型企業造成挑戰。

potential.en: The new method has great potential for saving both time and energy.
potential.zh: 這種新方法很有潛力同時節省時間與能源。

precise.en: Scientists need precise measurements when comparing very small differences.
precise.zh: 科學家比較非常細微的差異時需要精確測量。

predict.en: The model can predict changes in temperature with reasonable accuracy.
predict.zh: 這個模型能以合理準確度預測溫度變化。

prediction.en: Her prediction was based on patterns found in earlier data.
prediction.zh: 她的預測是根據先前資料中的模式做出的。

preserve.en: The project aims to preserve historic buildings in the neighborhood.
preserve.zh: 這項計畫旨在保存社區中的歷史建築。

principle.en: The teacher explained the principle with a simple real-world example.
principle.zh: 老師用簡單的真實例子解釋這項原理。

priority.en: Student safety should always remain the highest priority during experiments.
priority.zh: 學生安全在實驗中應永遠是最高優先事項。

procedure.en: Follow the procedure carefully so the results can be compared fairly.
procedure.zh: 請仔細遵循程序，讓結果可以公平比較。

proceed.en: The class will proceed to the next activity after a short break.
proceed.zh: 短暫休息後，全班會繼續進行下一個活動。

professional.en: The speaker gave professional advice about preparing for future careers.
professional.zh: 講者提供了有關未來職涯準備的專業建議。

proportion.en: A large proportion of the class preferred the second design.
proportion.zh: 班上很大比例的學生偏好第二個設計。

prospect.en: The prospect of studying abroad encouraged her to improve her English.
prospect.zh: 出國留學的前景鼓勵她提升英文能力。

protocol.en: The research team followed a strict protocol when collecting samples.
protocol.zh: 研究團隊採集樣本時遵循嚴格流程。

prove.en: One experiment cannot prove that a theory is always correct.
prove.zh: 單一實驗不能證明某個理論永遠正確。

psychology.en: Psychology examines how people think, feel, and behave in different situations.
psychology.zh: 心理學研究人們在不同情境下如何思考、感受與行動。

publish.en: The school plans to publish the winning essays next month.
publish.zh: 學校計畫下個月刊登得獎文章。

purchase.en: The library will purchase more reference books for senior students.
purchase.zh: 圖書館將為高年級學生購買更多參考書。

qualify.en: Students must qualify through the first round before entering the final.
qualify.zh: 學生必須先通過第一輪資格才能進入決賽。

quantity.en: The experiment compares how quantity affects the final result.
quantity.zh: 這項實驗比較數量如何影響最後結果。

radical.en: The proposal suggests a radical change to the current transportation system.
radical.zh: 這項提案建議對目前交通系統進行徹底改變。

range.en: The survey included students from a wide range of backgrounds.
range.zh: 這項調查包含來自各種不同背景的學生。

react.en: Some materials react differently when they are exposed to heat.
react.zh: 有些材料接觸熱能時會有不同反應。

reaction.en: The chemical reaction released enough heat to change the temperature.
reaction.zh: 這個化學反應釋放了足以改變溫度的熱量。

reasonable.en: The teacher gave us a reasonable amount of time to finish.
reasonable.zh: 老師給了我們合理的時間完成任務。

recover.en: The local economy began to recover after several difficult months.
recover.zh: 經過幾個艱難月份後，當地經濟開始復甦。

refer.en: Please refer to the chart when explaining the change in results.
refer.zh: 解釋結果變化時請參考圖表。

reference.en: The report includes a reference to several earlier studies.
reference.zh: 這份報告引用了幾項早期研究。

reflect.en: The final score may reflect both effort and understanding.
reflect.zh: 最後成績可能同時反映努力與理解程度。

regard.en: Many students regard the library as their favorite study place.
regard.zh: 許多學生把圖書館視為最喜歡的讀書地點。

region.en: This region receives heavy rain during the summer months.
region.zh: 這個地區夏季會有大量降雨。

relevant.en: Please include only relevant information in your final answer.
relevant.zh: 請只在最後答案中包含相關資訊。

reluctant.en: He was reluctant to speak until the teacher encouraged him.
reluctant.zh: 在老師鼓勵之前，他不太願意發言。

rely.en: Good decisions should rely on evidence rather than guesswork.
rely.zh: 好的決定應該依靠證據，而不是猜測。

remove.en: Please remove unnecessary details before submitting the final report.
remove.zh: 提交最後報告前請刪除不必要的細節。

requirement.en: Regular attendance is a basic requirement for completing the course.
requirement.zh: 規律出席是完成這門課的基本要求。

resist.en: Some materials can resist high temperatures better than others.
resist.zh: 有些材料比其他材料更能耐高溫。

resolve.en: The group met after class to resolve the remaining disagreement.
resolve.zh: 小組下課後開會解決剩下的分歧。

resource.en: The website provides a useful resource for students reviewing vocabulary.
resource.zh: 這個網站為複習單字的學生提供有用資源。

respond.en: Students should respond clearly to each question on the worksheet.
respond.zh: 學生應清楚回答學習單上的每個問題。

response.en: Her response showed that she understood the main idea.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她理解了主要概念。

restrict.en: The school may restrict access to the laboratory after hours.
restrict.zh: 學校可能限制放學後進入實驗室。

retain.en: Regular review helps students retain new vocabulary for longer.
retain.zh: 規律複習能幫助學生更久記住新單字。

reveal.en: The survey results reveal a change in students' study habits.
reveal.zh: 調查結果顯示學生的讀書習慣出現變化。

revise.en: Please revise your essay after reading the teacher's comments.
revise.zh: 閱讀老師評語後請修改你的作文。

revision.en: The final revision made the argument clearer and more convincing.
revision.zh: 最後一次修改讓論點更清楚、更有說服力。

role.en: Technology plays an important role in modern education.
role.zh: 科技在現代教育中扮演重要角色。

rough.en: The rough surface created more friction during the experiment.
rough.zh: 粗糙的表面在實驗中產生更多摩擦力。

routine.en: A regular study routine can make exam preparation less stressful.
routine.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能讓考試準備更不焦慮。
